mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy, which reduces discount rates for equity cash flows and drives positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 90% of its 12-month moving average signals an impending economic slowdown, causing investors to reduce equity exposure and drive negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST falls below 90% of its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a coordinated monetary easing and strengthening labor market, which together drive positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns by boosting corporate earnings and reducing risk premiums.
regime_hint: monetary easing with labor market strength
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both FEDFUNDS and UNRATE decline over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: In a strong labor market (defined by PAYEMS growth exceeding 0.5% in the prior month), a further acceleration in payroll growth (PAYEMS growth > 0.6%) signals robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.6% and the prior month's PAYEMS growth was above 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the past three months signals improving labor market conditions, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE has declined over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95% of its 12-month moving average signals an economic contraction, causing investors to sell equities and drive negative S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO falls below 95% of its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 2.0%) and low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 2.5%) signals a stable economic environment with accommodative monetary policy, which supports equity valuations and drives positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL < 2.0% and FEDFUNDS < 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In a strong consumer spending regime (RSAFS growth exceeding 0.5% in the prior month), a further acceleration in retail sales (RSAFS growth > 0.6%) signals robust household demand, driving positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS growth exceeds 0.6% and the prior month's RSAFS growth was above 0.5%.
